method: Colors sampled from the design's 1x renders, type fitted to text layer widths, sizes and radii from layer geometry; each component compared side by side with the screens it comes from, and 27 computed-style checks (test/fixtures/reference-styles.json) run in the browser. Components marked extrapolated have no counterpart in the design and extend its patterns.
